fundamental.summary: DTE shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 16 days adds execution risk.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional signal and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (411.84), flat yield curve, imminent CPI event (0 days), and earnings in 16 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop with elevated binary risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX-confirmed strong trend with multiple overbought signals (RSI 14, Stoch) in fear-zone contrarian setup offers technical entry structure near support (118.73) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis VIX, imminent CPI event, earnings in 16 days, stalling momentum (RSI 9/14 not rising), weak volume (0.82 ratio), zero fundamental conviction, and price below TEMA create a toxic macro/micro backdrop that overwhelms technical strength.
